description: List the authenticated user's recent calls, newest first, with statuses and outcomes. Useful to recover a lost call_id or review call history. Pass the returned next_cursor as cursor to fetch the next page of older calls. next_cursor is null when no older calls remain. Omit cursor to start at the newest calls. limit defaults to 20 (1–100) on every request.

cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor from a previous list_calls response. Omit for newest calls.

name: list_calls

call_id.description: Call identifier used with get_call, end_call and set_call_visibility.

duration_seconds.description: Connected duration in seconds, or zero before connecting.

is_public.description: Whether the call has a public link.

anyOf.description: Resolution outcome, unknown when it could not be determined, or pending while terminal analysis is not ready.
Pass as cursor to fetch older calls; null at the end.

phone.description: Account caller ID in E.164 format.

outputSchema.description: Successful result or a machine-readable tool error.
